# xr commands

## xr

```text
Usage: xr [options] [command]

Create, sync and remove the same git worktree branch across many sibling repos.

Options:
  -V, --version           print the version
  --codebase-path <path>  path to the codebase
  --json                  print the result as one JSON object
  --no-interactive        never ask questions
  --verbose               print the stack trace of an internal error
  -h, --help              print this help

Commands:
  doctor                  check the codebase or the project of this folder;
                          print each problem with its fix
  config                  show the config
  codebase                set up and change the codebase
  project                 make and change projects
```

## xr doctor

```text
Usage: xr doctor [options]

check the codebase or the project of this folder; print each problem with its
fix

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr config show

```text
Usage: xr config show [options]

print the merged config and the file that gives each value

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr codebase init

```text
Usage: xr codebase init [options]

make this folder a codebase of the git repos in it

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr codebase clone

```text
Usage: xr codebase clone [options]

clone each repo of the codebase that is not on disk

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr codebase pull

```text
Usage: xr codebase pull [options]

fast-forward the checked-out branch of each repo of the codebase on disk

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr codebase doctor

```text
Usage: xr codebase doctor [options]

check the codebase config, repo folders and AGENTS.md; print each problem with
its fix

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr codebase repo list

```text
Usage: xr codebase repo list [options]

print each repo of the codebase and whether it is on disk

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr codebase repo add

```text
Usage: xr codebase repo add [options] <url> [name] | <folder>

clone a repo into the codebase, or add a repo folder that is already in it

Arguments:
  url|folder  a git URL to clone, or a repo folder in the codebase
  name        the repo name for a URL; default: the last part of the URL

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr codebase repo remove

```text
Usage: xr codebase repo remove [options] [name]

remove a repo from the codebase config and AGENTS.md, and delete its folder

Arguments:
  name           the name of the repo in the codebase config

Options:
  --keep-folder  keep the repo folder; remove only the entry
  --force        delete the folder even when it has work that is not pushed
  -h, --help     print this help
```

## xr project create

```text
Usage: xr project create [options] <branch> [repo...] | <branch> --all

make a project folder with a worktree of each chosen repo on one branch

Arguments:
  branch      the branch of the project
  repo        the repos of the project; default: pick them

Options:
  --all       use every repo of the codebase
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr project list

```text
Usage: xr project list [options]

print each project of the codebase with its branch and repos

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr project info

```text
Usage: xr project info [options] [project]

print the branch, folder and repos of one project

Arguments:
  project     the project folder name or branch; default: the current project

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr project sync

```text
Usage: xr project sync [options] [project]

fetch origin and merge the default branch into each worktree of one project

Arguments:
  project     the project folder name or branch; default: the current project

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr project doctor

```text
Usage: xr project doctor [options] [project]

check one project and its codebase, and give a fix for each problem

Arguments:
  project     the project folder name or branch; default: the current project

Options:
  -h, --help  print this help
```

## xr project remove

```text
Usage: xr project remove [options] [project]

remove the worktrees and the folder of one project; keep the branches

Arguments:
  project          the project folder name or branch

Options:
  --force          remove worktrees even when they have uncommitted changes
  --delete-branch  also delete each merged branch with `git branch -d`
  -h, --help       print this help
```

## xr project repo add

```text
Usage: xr project repo add [options] [repos...]

add a worktree of each repo to the project

Arguments:
  repos                the repos to add; default: pick them

Options:
  --project <project>  the project folder name or branch; default: the current
                       project
  -h, --help           print this help
```

## xr project repo remove

```text
Usage: xr project repo remove [options] [repos...]

remove the worktree of each repo from the project

Arguments:
  repos                the repos to remove; default: pick them

Options:
  --project <project>  the project folder name or branch; default: the current
                       project
  --force              remove worktrees even when they have uncommitted changes
  --delete-branch      also delete each merged branch with `git branch -d`
  -h, --help           print this help
```

## xr project repo list

```text
Usage: xr project repo list [options]

print each repo of the project and whether its worktree folder exists

Options:
  --project <project>  the project folder name or branch; default: the current
                       project
  -h, --help           print this help
```
